QUOTE: "When `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is on, `mbedtls_calloc` and `mbedtls_free` become macros... When `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is off, the library uses the function-pointer dispatch above."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names both a compile-time macro route and a runtime setter route. It ties the choice to a different switch (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`) and never says the two substitution mechanisms are mutually exclusive.
